files.config.toml:
sandbox_mode = "workspace-write"
web_search = "disabled"

[features]
shell_tool = true
multi_agent = true
hooks = true

[tools]
web_search = false
view_image = true

[sandbox_workspace_write]
writable_roots = ["/wt", "/scratch", "/bun", "/git"]
network_access = true

[features.network_proxy]
enabled = true

[features.network_proxy.domains]
"github.com" = "allow"
"api.github.com" = "allow"
"raw.githubusercontent.com" = "allow"
"codeload.github.com" = "allow"
"objects.githubusercontent.com" = "allow"
"registry.npmjs.org" = "allow"
"api.anthropic.com" = "allow"

[mcp_servers.vinaya_dev_tools]
enabled = true
command = "/bridge"
args = []
tool_timeout_sec = 1800
enabled_tools = ["fetch_documentation","run_checks","publish_changes","open_pull_request","update_pull_request_body","refresh_evidence","read_pull_request"]
default_tools_approval_mode = "approve"

[[hooks.PreToolUse]]
matcher = "^(Bash|apply_patch|update_plan|view_image|web_fetch|spawn_agent|send_input|resume_agent|wait_agent|close_agent)$"

[[hooks.PreToolUse.hooks]]
type = "command"
command = "node \"/gen/developer/hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs\""
timeout = 30
